question: Gurdwara Panja Sahib is located in ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is ** Pakistan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Location:** Gurdwara Panja Sahib is situated in Hasanabdal, Pakistan.
 
• **Historical Significance:** It is a revered Sikh shrine commemorating the visit of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the founder of Sikhism.
 
• **Sacred Symbol:** The gurdwara derives its name from the imprint of Guru Nanak Dev Ji's hand (panja) on a rock, which is considered a sacred symbol.
 
• **Architectural Beauty:** The gurdwara boasts beautiful architecture, including a large golden dome and serene gardens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Proposed Corridor:** The Panja Sahib Corridor is a proposed corridor connecting the Sikh shrines in Pakistan, including Gurdwara Panja Sahib, with India.
 
• **Facilitating Pilgrimages:** The corridor aims to facilitate pilgrimages for Sikh devotees from India to these shrines in Pakistan.
 
• **Cultural Exchange:** It is expected to promote cultural exchange and strengthen ties between the two countries.
 
• **Ongoing Negotiations:** Negotiations between India and Pakistan regarding the Panja Sahib Corridor are ongoing.
